minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  SPECIAL MEETING
  NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF
  THE INGLEWOOD ARTS COMMISSION

  Inglewood, California
  February 10, 2026

A special meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission convened on February 10, 2026.
Chairman Jacques Lesure called the meeting to order at 5:00 p.m., followed by the flag
salute.

Ramara Rubin announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:
   Commissioner Aletha Metcalf, District No. 1
   Commissioner Anya Christiansen, District No. 4
   Chairman Jacques Lesure, Commissioner at Large
  Absent:
   Commissioner Olivia Alvitre, District No. 2
   Commissioner Phyllis Battle, District No. 3

  City Personnel present were as follows:
   Kerri Arroyo  Library Director
   Ramara Rubin  Secretary

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None.

SPECIAL PRESENTATION.
  a. Rasta Asaru El of Creative House Gallery provided an overview of the project
  revisions, including the reduction in the number of boxes and participating
  artists. An update was given on the ongoing site selection process for the 25
  boxes, the estimated annual maintenance cost of approximately $20,000,
  presented an itemized chart outlining ownership and rights (noting the City’s
  ownership), and outlined the payment schedule and projected the
  completion timeline.
  i. Discussion followed regarding responsibility for severe damage
  and insurance coverage.
   Arts Commission

  MOTION #1. Commissioner Christiansen moved, and Commissioner Metcalf seconded,
  that the installation of the next 25 utility boxes be approved.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Christiansen, and Lesure
  Noes: None

  a. Kerri Arroyo, Library Director, discussed the procurement process and the
  need for three quotes for projects over $25,000.
  b. Discussion was held regarding the prior project’s procurement process and
  current budget constraints. The need to renegotiate costs to remain within
  the $25,000 limit was noted. It was suggested that an RFP be developed and
  additional information gathered for presentation at the next meeting.

  MOTION #2. Commissioner Metcalf moved, and Commissioner Christiansen seconded,
  to reconsider the vote by which the installation of the next 25 utility boxes was
  approved.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Christiansen, and Lesure
  Noes: None

  a. Discussion was held regarding postponing the matter to obtain additional
  information.

  MOTION #3. Commissioner Christiansen moved, and Commissioner Metcalf seconded,
  to table the matter until the next meeting.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Christiansen, and Lesure
  Noes: None

  PUBLIC REMARKS. None.

  COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Commissioner Metcalf shared updates on her poetry class at the Senior
  Center.
  b. Chairman Lesure shared their excitement about being a guest artist at the
  City of Inglewood Black History Celebration & Family Festival with the Yola
  jazz band.

There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Lesure declared the meeting
adjourned at 5:41 p.m.
